scenario: 面试官说：设计一个支持创建文件/目录、路径导航和基本文件操作的内存文件系统，只保留单根目录树。
q: 这个内存文件系统的基础能力包含哪些？（多选）
options: 单根目录的层级树
文件存储字符串内容
创建、删除、列出、重命名、移动文件或文件夹
支持相对路径、权限、持久化和符号链接
why: 范围是内存中的单根绝对路径树：创建、删除、列出、重命名、移动加内容存储。相对路径、权限、持久化、符号链接都被面试官明确排除。
why_en: The base file system is an in-memory, single-root, absolute-path tree with string content plus five core mutation operations.
options_en: A hierarchical tree under a single root.
Files store string content.
Create, delete, list, rename, and move files or folders.
Support relative paths, permissions, persistence, and symlinks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从根目录 / 开始书写的完整路径，如 /home/user/notes.txt。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An absolute path is a full path written from the root, such as /home/user/notes.txt.

q_en: Which base capabilities does this in-memory file system support? (multi-select)
scenario_en: The interviewer says: design an in-memory file system that supports creating files/folders, path navigation, and basic file operations, keeping just a single-root tree.
optionExplanations: 单根树是这套内存文件系统的骨架，后续所有路径都从这一个 root 出发解析。
文件不区分类型，统一按字符串存内容，省去序列化和类型系统的复杂度。
这五个操作对应最终需求清单，是这版实现必须跑通的最小操作集。
这四项每个都单独被面试官划出范围，实现里不用为它们预留接口。
optionExplanations_en: The single root gives this in-memory tree one entry point that every path resolves from.
Files skip type distinctions and just hold string content, avoiding serialization overhead.
These five operations are the minimum command set this version has to support end to end.
Each of these four was explicitly carved out by the interviewer, so there's no need to design for them here.

scenario: 需求中反复出现 /home/user/docs 这类路径。
q: Path 应该如何建模？
options: 作为独立实体，自己保存全局状态和子节点列表
定义成 Folder 的子类类型
字符串输入，由 FileSystem 解析
定义成 File 的父类类型
why: 路径是定位输入，不拥有生命周期或可变状态；把解析逻辑集中在 FileSystem helper 里就够。
why_en: Path is just an input string to resolve, not a domain entity with its own state.
tradeoff: Path 作为无状态输入字符串 vs 独立 Path/Resolver 实体
whenOtherWins: 如果支持相对路径、规范化、符号链接、挂载点和权限检查，Path/Resolver 可能值得独立建模。
options_en: A standalone entity that holds its own global state and list of children.
Defined as a subclass of Folder.
A string input that FileSystem resolves.
Defined as a superclass of File.

termDefinitions.meaning: 标识树中某个位置的字符串，例如 /home/user/docs。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A path is a string that identifies a location in the tree, such as /home/user/docs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有 root 并对外提供路径 API 的入口类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSystem is the entry-point class that owns the root and exposes the path-based API.

q_en: How should Path be modeled?
scenario_en: The requirements repeatedly reference paths like /home/user/docs.
optionExplanations: 把 Path 做成有状态的实体会引入生命周期管理，但这里连规范化都不需要，纯属过度设计。
路径和文件夹是两种不同的概念，硬塞进 Folder 继承体系会让类型语义变乱。
路径只是定位输入，交给 FileSystem 统一解析成 parent+name，不用为它单独建模。
File 不该从一个字符串概念派生，这个继承方向在语义上说不通。
optionExplanations_en: Turning Path into a stateful object with its own identity is over-engineering when you don't even need normalization yet.
A path and a folder are different concepts, so wedging Path under Folder's hierarchy corrupts the type semantics.
Path is just a location input that FileSystem resolves into parent and name, so it doesn't need its own model.
File shouldn't derive from a string-like concept — that inheritance direction doesn't make sense here.

scenario: 调用方想 createFile('/home/user/notes.txt','hi')，不想手动从 root 一层层导航。
q: 为什么需要 FileSystem 类？
options: 因为 Folder 不能包含 File
因为 FileSystem 存储每个文件内容
为了完全替代 Folder 和 File 这两个类
作为 facade，集中处理路径解析和公共 API
why: FileSystem 隐藏路径拆分、导航和校验细节，避免每个调用方重复实现；它是系统入口，不是叶子节点。
why_en: FileSystem acts as a facade over root navigation, centralizing path parsing behind one public API.
tradeoff: 集中路径解析的 facade 入口 vs 调用方各自手写导航逻辑
whenOtherWins: 如果 API 只面向已持有 Folder 引用的内部代码，直接操作 Folder 也可以；但用户级路径 API 需要 facade。
options_en: Because Folder cannot contain File.
Because FileSystem stores every file's content.
To fully replace both Folder and File as classes.
As a facade that centralizes path parsing and the public API.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个简单入口类隐藏子系统内部复杂性的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Facade pattern hides a subsystem's internal complexity behind one simple entry-point class.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有 root 并对外提供路径 API 的入口类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSystem is the entry-point class that owns the root and exposes the path-based API.

q_en: Why do we need a FileSystem class?
scenario_en: A caller wants to call createFile('/home/user/notes.txt','hi') without manually navigating from root.
optionExplanations: Folder 本来就能通过 addChild 装 File，这从来不是引入 FileSystem 的原因。
内容其实存在 File.content 上，FileSystem 并不代管每个文件的字节。
Folder 和 File 仍然各司其职，FileSystem 只是在它们之上加一层编排，不是替代品。
FileSystem 拥有 root，把路径拆分和逐级导航都收在一个入口，调用方只用记一个 API。
optionExplanations_en: Folder can already hold File via addChild, so that was never the reason FileSystem exists.
Content actually lives on File.content — FileSystem doesn't stash every file's bytes itself.
Folder and File still keep their own jobs; FileSystem just orchestrates on top, it doesn't replace them.
FileSystem owns root and folds path-splitting and step-by-step navigation into one entry point, so callers only need one API.

q: 这个内存文件系统的类设计要落地哪些类型？（多选）
options: FileSystem
FileSystemEntry
Folder
File
Path
why: FileSystem 负责编排，FileSystemEntry 抽取共享身份，Folder 是 composite，File 是 leaf；Path 不作为实体，只是解析输入。
why_en: The design uses FileSystem, a shared FileSystemEntry abstraction, Folder composites, and File leaves — Path stays a plain string.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class FileSystem
  class FileSystemEntry
  class Folder
  class File
  FileSystem --> Folder : root
  FileSystemEntry <|-- Folder
  FileSystemEntry <|-- File
  Folder --> FileSystemEntry : children
options_en: FileSystem
FileSystemEntry
Folder
File
Path

termDefinitions.meaning: File 和 Folder 共同的抽象基类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSystemEntry is the shared abstract base class for File and Folder.

termDefinitions.meaning: 可以包含子节点的容器类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A composite is a container type that can hold child nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不能再包含子节点的树末端节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A leaf is a tree node that cannot contain further children.

q_en: Which types does this in-memory file system actually implement? (multi-select)
optionExplanations: FileSystem 是持有 root 并对外暴露公共 API 的入口类，属于最终类型清单。
它把 File 和 Folder 共有的 name/parent 字段抽成一个共享基类。
Folder 是能装子节点的 composite 容器，是树里唯一有 children 的类型。
File 是叶子节点，只多带一个字符串内容字段，没有子节点。
Path 从没被当成一个类来实现，它只是传给 FileSystem 方法的字符串参数。
optionExplanations_en: FileSystem is the entry-point class that owns root and exposes the public API, so it's on the final type list.
It pulls the shared name/parent fields off File and Folder into one common base class.
Folder is the composite container that can hold children — the only type in the tree with a children map.
File is the leaf node, carrying just one extra string content field and no children.
Path was never implemented as a class — it's just a string argument passed into FileSystem's methods.
scenario: 设计内存文件系统：目录可任意深度嵌套，所有 API 只接收 "/a/b/c" 字符串来定位节点。
scenario_en: We are designing an in-memory file system: folders nest to any depth, and every API call locates a node with a "/a/b/c" string.

scenario: File 和 Folder 各自实现了几乎相同的 name、parent、getPath、isDirectory，代码明显重复。
q: FileSystemEntry 抽象解决了什么问题？
options: 它让 File 也能像 Folder 一样包含并管理子节点
File/Folder 共享字段与方法，children 需统一类型
它替代了 FileSystem 里的路径解析器，不再需要 resolvePath
它负责对每个文件的内容做全文关键词搜索和索引
why: 文件树里 leaf 和 composite 都是 entry；共享抽象减少重复，并让 Folder.children 的类型可以统一。
why_en: FileSystemEntry captures the shared node identity for both files and folders in the tree.
tradeoff: 共享基类统一身份 vs 各自独立类型省去继承耦合
options_en: It lets File contain and manage children like Folder does.
File/Folder share fields and methods, and children need one shared type.
It replaces FileSystem's path resolver, so resolvePath is no longer needed.
It handles full-text keyword search and indexing over every file's content.

termDefinitions.meaning: File 和 Folder 共同的抽象基类，封装 name/parent/getPath。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSystemEntry is the shared abstract base class holding name, parent, and getPath for both files and folders.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用来区分一个 entry 是文件夹还是文件的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: isDirectory is the method that tells whether an entry is a folder or a file.

q_en: What problem does the FileSystemEntry abstraction solve?
scenario_en: File and Folder each implement almost identical name, parent, getPath, and isDirectory, and the duplication is obvious.
optionExplanations: File 依然是叶子节点，这个抽象并不会给它加上管理子节点的能力。
File 和 Folder 共享 name/parent/getPath 等字段方法，抽出基类还能让 children 用统一类型存两种节点。
路径解析仍是 FileSystem.resolvePath 的职责，这个抽象跟它无关。
全文搜索是完全独立的功能扩展，跟节点身份抽象没有关系。
optionExplanations_en: File stays a leaf — this abstraction doesn't give it any child-managing power.
File and Folder share fields like name/parent/getPath, and the shared base also lets children hold one uniform type covering both.
Path resolution still belongs to FileSystem.resolvePath — this abstraction has nothing to do with it.
Full-text search is a completely separate extension, unrelated to node identity.

scenario: File 和 Folder 都稳定共享 name、parent、getPath 行为。
q: 为什么 abstract class 比只有 interface 更合适？
options: 能共享字段和 getPath 实现，interface 只有契约
interface 从 Java 8 起也有 default method，能共享方法体
abstract class 能自动把 File/Folder 状态持久化到磁盘
Folder 只是容器，用组合代替继承也能达到同样效果
why: 这里共享的不只是方法名，还有稳定实现；继承在真实 is-a 关系且共享行为稳定时是合理选择。
why_en: An abstract class is justified because File and Folder share stable state and behavior, not just a method contract.
tradeoff: 共享实现的 abstract class vs 只共享契约的 interface
whenOtherWins: 如果语言偏组合，或两者只共享很少契约，interface 加工具函数也可以。
options_en: It can share fields and the getPath implementation, while an interface only has a contract.
Since Java 8, interfaces also have default methods that can share a method body.
An abstract class can automatically persist File/Folder state to disk.
Folder is just a container; composition instead of inheritance can achieve the same effect.

termDefinitions.meaning: 可以包含共享字段和默认实现、但不能直接实例化的类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An abstract class can hold shared fields and default implementations but cannot be instantiated directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: interface 里可以提供默认实现、但仍不能持有实例字段的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A default method lets an interface provide a default implementation, but the interface still cannot hold instance fields.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只定义方法契约、不提供共享实现的类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An interface defines a method contract without providing shared implementation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用统一类型引用不同子类对象，并调用各自实现的能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Polymorphism lets code refer to different subclass objects through one shared type and call their own implementations.

q_en: Why is an abstract class a better fit here than a plain interface?
scenario_en: File and Folder both stably share name, parent, and getPath behavior.
optionExplanations: File 和 Folder 能直接继承 getPath 等方法实现，不用各自重写一遍，这正是选 abstract class 的理由。
default method 能共享方法体，但接口仍不能持有实例字段，abstract class 才能两者都要。
抽象类本身跟磁盘持久化毫无关系，这版设计里 File/Folder 状态只存在内存中。
组合确实是候选方案，但 File/Folder 是稳定的 is-a 关系且共享字段，继承在这里更直接。
optionExplanations_en: File and Folder can inherit getPath's real implementation instead of each rewriting it — that's the actual case for an abstract class.
A default method can share a method body, but an interface still can't hold instance fields — only an abstract class gives you both.
An abstract class has nothing to do with disk persistence — in this design, File/Folder state only ever lives in memory.
Composition is a real alternative, but File and Folder have a stable is-a relationship and share fields, so inheritance is the more direct fit here.

q: 补全 Composite 结构：
text: File 是不能包含 children 的 {{leaf}}；Folder 是可以包含 FileSystemEntry 的 {{composite}}；FileSystemEntry 是二者共同的 {{节点抽象}}。
why: 文件系统天然是树；统一节点抽象让外层代码可以把文件和文件夹当作 entry 统一处理。
why_en: The file system naturally fits the Composite pattern: File is the leaf and Folder is the composite, sharing one entry abstraction.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class FileSystemEntry
  class Folder
  class FileEntry
  FileSystemEntry <|-- Folder
  FileSystemEntry <|-- FileEntry
  Folder --> FileSystemEntry

termDefinitions.meaning: 让叶子节点和容器节点共用同一接口的设计模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Composite pattern lets leaf and container nodes share one common interface.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不能再包含子节点的节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A leaf node cannot contain further children.

termDefinitions.meaning: 可以包含子节点的容器节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A composite node can contain child nodes.

q_en: Fill in the Composite structure:

scenario: 需要从任意 File 或 Folder 引用得到完整路径，并支持 rename/move。
q: 为什么优先存 parent 指针而不是每个 entry 存 full path 字符串？
options: getPath 无论目录树多深，都必须保持 O(1) 常数时间返回
parent 指针除了定位还能自动搜索文件内容
rename/move 只改 name/parent，路径按需计算
full path 字符串无法正确显示中文文件名
why: 存 full path 会让重命名大目录时必须更新所有后代路径；parent 指针把 rename/move 降为局部更新，getPath 付出 O(depth)。
why_en: Parent pointers avoid cascading path updates on rename or move, trading O(1) getPath for O(depth).
tradeoff: parent 指针的局部更新 vs full path 字符串的级联更新
whenOtherWins: 如果几乎只读路径且很少 move/rename，可缓存路径字符串，但要有失效策略。
options_en: getPath must return in O(1) constant time no matter how deep the directory tree gets.
Parent pointers can also automatically search file content.
Rename/move only changes name/parent; the path is computed on demand.
Full path strings cannot correctly display Chinese file names.

termDefinitions.meaning: 子节点保存的指向父节点的引用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parent pointer is the reference a child node keeps back to its parent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作耗时随树的深度增长，而不是随节点总数增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(depth) means the operation's cost grows with the tree's depth, not with the total number of nodes.

q_en: Why store a parent pointer instead of a full path string on every entry?
scenario_en: You need to compute the full path from any File or Folder reference, and support rename/move.
optionExplanations: getPath 用 parent 指针其实是 O(depth) 而非 O(1)，这不是这里权衡的目标。
parent 指针只负责定位和导航，不做任何内容层面的搜索。
重命名或移动时只需要改这一个 entry 的 name/parent，getPath 再按需要往上拼一次。
路径字符串本身跟字符集无关，这不是工程上真实存在的限制。
optionExplanations_en: getPath over parent pointers is actually O(depth), not O(1) — that's not the tradeoff being made here.
Parent pointers only handle locating and navigating, never any content-level search.
Rename or move only touches that one entry's name/parent, and getPath just walks up on demand afterward.
A path string's encoding has nothing to do with the character set — that's not a real engineering constraint.

q: 按顺序排列存 full path 字符串导致的问题：
steps: 如果 /home 被重命名为 /house，所有后代路径前缀都变了。
每个 entry 持有自己的 path 字符串。
必须遍历整个子树更新每个 path。
一次 rename/move 从局部操作变成 O(descendants)。
why: 这就是 parent 指针方案胜出的主要理由：深层目录下路径字符串冗余会让简单操作变复杂。
why_en: Storing full paths on every entry turns a folder rename or move into a cascading update across all descendants.
tradeoff: 存 full path 读取简单 vs parent 指针写入简单但读取要递归

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 entry 自己保存的完整路径字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A full path is the complete path string stored directly on each entry.

termDefinitions.meaning: 某个节点子树下所有更深层的节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A descendant is any node deeper in the subtree rooted at a given node.

q_en: Order the problems caused by storing full path strings:

scenario: Folder 需要根据名称快速定位某个子节点，同时保证同一文件夹内没有重名。
q: Folder.children 为什么用 Map<string, FileSystemEntry> 而不是 List？
options: List<FileSystemEntry> 完全不能保存任何多态对象
Map 在按名查找时会自动递归搜索整个子树
List 结构本身无法列出文件夹里的内容
Map 用 O(1) 按名查找子节点，并天然保证同目录唯一名
why: 路径解析每一级都要按名称查子节点；Map 同时提升查询效率，并把'同一文件夹内名称唯一'变成数据结构约束。
why_en: A map keyed by child name gives O(1) path-resolution lookups and enforces unique names within a folder.
tradeoff: Map 的 O(1) 查找+天然唯一名 vs List 的顺序但 O(n) 扫描
options_en: List<FileSystemEntry> cannot hold any polymorphic objects at all.
A map automatically recurses into the whole subtree when looking up by name.
A list structure itself cannot list a folder's contents.
A map gives O(1) lookup by name and naturally enforces unique names per folder.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以子节点名称为 key、entry 为 value 的哈希表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Map<string, FileSystemEntry> is a hash table keyed by child name with the entry as the value.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作耗时不随数据规模增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) means the operation's time does not grow as the data size grows.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作耗时随元素数量 n 线性增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) means the operation's time grows linearly with the number n of elements.

q_en: Why does Folder.children use Map<string, FileSystemEntry> instead of a List?
scenario_en: Folder needs to quickly locate a child by name while guaranteeing no duplicate names within one folder.
optionExplanations: List 完全能装任意类型的对象，这个限制本身就是编造的。
Map 只做单层 key 查找，并不会自动往子树里递归。
List 本身完全能枚举出文件夹内容，这不是选 Map 的理由。
Map 按名字 O(1) 查子节点，还顺带让重名冲突变成插入时就能检测到的结构约束。
optionExplanations_en: A list can hold any object type just fine — this restriction is simply made up.
A map only does one-level key lookup; it never auto-recurses into a subtree.
A list can enumerate a folder's contents perfectly well, so that's not the reason to pick a map.
A map gives O(1) lookup by name and turns duplicate names into something caught at insert time.

scenario: FileSystem 是唯一入口，所有操作都通过它的公共方法完成。
q: FileSystem 的公共 API 通常包括哪些？（多选）
options: createFile(path,content)
createFolder(path)
delete(path)
list(path)
get(path)
rename(path,newName)
move(srcPath,destPath)
chmod(path,permissions) 设置权限
why: 这些方法直接映射最终需求；公共 API 以绝对路径为入口，内部用 helper 解析。权限管理不在这版范围内。
why_en: The FileSystem public API maps directly to create, delete, list, get, rename, and move — permissions stay out of scope.
options_en: createFile(path, content)
createFolder(path)
delete(path)
list(path)
get(path)
rename(path, newName)
move(srcPath, destPath)
chmod(path, permissions) to set permissions

termDefinitions.meaning: Unix 里修改文件权限的命令/概念，这里代表权限管理功能。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: chmod is the Unix concept of changing file permissions, representing permission management here.

q_en: What does FileSystem's public API typically include? (multi-select)
scenario_en: FileSystem is the single entry point; every operation goes through its public methods.
optionExplanations: 对应'创建文件并写入初始内容'这个需求，是最基础的写操作。
对应'创建空目录'需求，内部走一次 resolvePath+addChild。
对应删除需求，默认让整个子树跟着消失。
对应列出目录需求，只对文件夹有意义。
对应按路径直接取到某个 entry 的需求，不管是文件还是文件夹。
对应改名需求，要同步维护 parent map 里的 key。
对应移动需求，要跨源、目标两个父目录同步更新。
权限管理被面试官明确划出这版范围，公共 API 不用留这个方法。
optionExplanations_en: Covers the 'create a file with initial content' requirement — the most basic write op.
Covers 'create an empty folder,' internally doing one resolvePath plus addChild.
